blocks.text: Bacteria apne qudrati (natural) mahol (environment) mein chalne aur ghoomne ke liye harkat (motility) ke mukhtalif tareeqe istemal karte hain. Kitaab chhe tareeqe batati hai: flagellar movement, twitching (crawling), gliding, sliding, Brownian movement aur axial filament se harkat.

Aksar bacilli aur spirilla flagella se chalte hain: woh tairte (swim karte) hain. Jab poori bacterial aabadi (population) flagella se ikatthi chalti hai to is harkat ko swarming kehte hain. Flagellar movement se bacteria liquid media mein safar karte hain. Flagellum ka counter-clockwise ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai aur flagellum peechhe ghisatta hai.

Twitching satah (surface) par chalne ke liye hota hai. Yeh pili ke zariye hota hai: pili aas paas ki thos (solid) satah se jur jate hain aur phir sikurte (retract hote) hain, to bacterial cell aage khinch jata hai.
Gliding twitching jaisa hi hai. Gliding mein bacteria ek chipchipa (slimy) madda nikalte hain jo thos satah par unhen aasani se phisalne mein madad deta hai.
Sliding taqseem hote (dividing) cells ke dhakke ki quwwat (force) se paida hone wale phailao (expansion) ki wajah se hoti hai.
Kuch bacteria jin ke paas na flagella hain na pili, jaise Streptococcus, apne gird fluid ke zarrat (particles) ki be-tarteeb aur be-qaboo (uncontrolled) harkat ki wajah se hilte hain.

Kuch bacteria, spirochaetes, ke paas ek badla hua (modified) flagellum hota hai jise axial filament kehte hain. Yeh ek sire par juda hota hai aur periplasmic space (cell membrane aur outer membrane ke darmiyan) mein lambai mein chalta hai. Yeh flagella jaise fibrils ke do sets se banta hai jo cell ke do poles par jure hote hain. Axial filament spirochaetes ko murne (flexing), tairne, rengne (creeping) aur ghoomne (spinning) mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek lamba spiral spirochaete cell. Us ke outer sheath ke andar, fibrils ke do sets har pole se lambai mein periplasmic space ke saath chalte hain aur darmiyan mein ek doosre par aate hain.
blocks.caption: Spirochaete ka axial filament (Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Cell ek lehrdaar spiral hai jo outer membrane mein band hai. Cell body us ke andar hai. Dono ke darmiyan, periplasmic space mein, baen pole se jure fibrils daen taraf aur daen pole se jure fibrils baen taraf chalte hain, to woh cell ke darmiyan ek doosre par aate hain. Labels outer membrane, periplasmic space, cell body aur fibrils ke do sets dikhate hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch qataarein. Swimming: mayi mein aik dande-numa cell peeche lage flagella se aage dhakela jata hai. Swarming: flagella wale cells ka group aik saath chalta hai. Twitching: satah par cell ka pilus aage chipak kar sukarta hai aur cell ko aage kheenchta hai. Gliding: cell slime chhor kar satah par phisalta hai. Sliding: taqseem hote cells ki zanjeer colony ko dono taraf bahar dhakelti hai.
blocks.caption: Bacteria ki harkat: swimming, swarming, twitching, gliding aur sliding (Figure 2.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Twitching aur gliding mein kya farq hai, aur Brownian movement bacterium ke appendages ke baare mein kya batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Twitching mein pili satah se jur kar sikurte hain aur cell ko khinchte hain; gliding mein nikala hua slime satah par aasan harkat deta hai. Brownian movement khud ki quwwat se nahin hoti: yeh un bacteria mein hoti hai jin ke paas flagella ya pili nahin, aur fluid ke zarrat unhen hilate hain.

items: Flagellar movement: liquid mein tairna; aabadi ikatthi chale to swarming; counter-clockwise ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai.
Twitching pili se (jurna aur sikurna); gliding slime se; sliding dividing cells ke dhakke se.
Brownian movement ghair-faal (passive) hai, un bacteria mein jin ke paas flagella ya pili nahin.
Spirochaetes axial filament istemal karte hain, periplasmic space mein modified flagellum, murne, tairne, rengne aur ghoomne ke liye.
